forbidden_claims.label: root_theorem_claim
forbidden_claims.reason: root theorem proposition is not citable solver context
forbidden_claims.statement_nl: Let [n choose k]_q denote the Gaussian q-binomial coefficient. Prove that for all integers n, k, ℓ with 0 ≤ k, ℓ ≤ n, if [n choose k]_q / [n choose ℓ]_q is a polynomial in q, then it has only nonnegative coefficients.

statement_nl: For all integers n and r with 0 <= r <= n, define the Gaussian q-binomial coefficient by [n choose r]_q := (q;q)_n / ((q;q)_r (q;q)_{n-r}), where (q;q)_m := product_{i=1}^m (1 - q^i) and (q;q)_0 := 1. Then [n choose r]_q = [n choose n-r]_q as polynomials in q.
